high_level_description: The image depicts a group of children gathered closely together outdoors, with a woman standing behind them, smiling warmly. The children appear to be schoolchildren, as many of them are wearing uniforms that include blue sweaters or shirts with white collars and ties. Some of the children have backpacks slung over their shoulders, suggesting they might be on their way to or from school. The woman is dressed in a light teal top with a decorative patterned trim around the neckline. She has her arms around some of the children, indicating a close and friendly interaction.
